name: flashes-floaters-poor
description: Poor call: books a routine GP appointment without asking what is wrong with the eye.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Good morning, is that the surgery? I'd like to book a routine appointment with the doctor, please.

transcript.speaker: trainee

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Oh, I see. Well, if that is the earliest. Thank you.
